visualCharacteristics.purpose: Dynamic, filterable grid of adventure cards driven by page metadata
visualCharacteristics.layout: Row of activity filter tabs above a responsive card grid

contentPattern.structure: Default: a marker block containing links to the adventure pages (or empty when a query-index is published). `children` variant: a single cell holding a parent page path; the block lists that parent's direct child pages from the query-index. Cards + filter tabs are built at render time from each page's Activity

options.name: children
options.description: List the direct child pages of an authored parent path (discovered via the query-index by path prefix) instead of authoring individual links. Renders nothing when the query-index is unavailable or the parent has no children.
